title: Clarification for the December 2026 term of Examination (Ref No. DoS-Academics/09/2026)
note: Official circular, 3 pages, dated 15/09/2026, SHA-256 of the retrieved file e505dd6f7b4d191f865aee2783d1d868a366955038f084770eb17abdd49ae752. States what applies to the December 2026 term for Syllabus 2022: Companies Act 2013, Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules 2014, CAS 1-24, Finance Act 2025, GST and Ind AS, each as amended up to 31 May 2026, for Papers 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10 (and Final papers). Names the study-material pages and the supplementary page as the way students get them. Its Paper 8 and Paper 10 rows mention supplementary material that the supplementary page does not list (recorded in the M5 review).

title: CMA Syllabus 2022 - Full Version
note: 84-page official document. SHA-256 of the retrieved file: 25b9b19a837974e2bbd65c1327dcfb85144148e1607aa3f246402a17a6196445. p.13: Intermediate course structure (Group I Papers 5-8, Group II Papers 9-12, 800 marks). pp.6, 13: 'CMA Syllabus - 2022 shall be effective from June 2023 term of examinations and onwards' (a term, not a calendar date, so syllabus effectiveFrom stays null). pp.28-49: Intermediate syllabus. Cross-checked against the per-paper PDFs. Three titles differ and this document's wording is used (approved by the maintainer 2026-11-08): Paper 6 Section D and Module 4 are 'Partnership Accounting' here but 'Partnership Accounts' in the Paper 6 PDF's summary table; Paper 7 Module 6 is 'Customs Act & Rules' here but 'Customs Act' in the Paper 7 PDF; Paper 11 Module 7 is 'Financing Decisions of a Firm' here but 'Financing Decision of a Firm' in the Paper 11 PDF's summary table. See docs/architecture/m5-curriculum-review.md section 5.

title: Intermediate and Final Examination Time Table & Programme - December 2026
note: Official ICMAI notice, 1 page, SHA-256 of the retrieved file: 2bec31e18b2f479ef72bdcce93373a76a63ddeebcd53001e955e534b8c79ac9d. The Intermediate column is headed 'PROGRAMME FOR SYLLABUS 2022'.
